versions.body:
{
  "read_first": [
    "docs/habitat_charter.md",
    "docs/literature_coverage.md",
    "3 most recent docs/*sweep*|*plan*|*design*",
    "sources/README.md"
  ],
  "pin": [
    "charter conventions",
    "literature_coverage state",
    "graph validation rule"
  ],
  "compress": [
    "older sweep docs",
    "search results"
  ],
  "do_not": [
    "re-sweep covered ground",
    "re-add a paper already in derived_from"
  ],
  "rules": [
    "IDLE-STATE RULE (run 80): if the last 3 runs were all doc-refresh / hygiene / 'other', AND an arXiv sweep returned nothing past the known frontier, AND tools/selftest_all.py is GREEN, then the run's increment must be one of: (a) deepen ONE existing node with a targeted citation sweep (S2 citations on its source), (b) dry-run one probe design from docs/emergence_probe_catalogue.md end to end, or (c) a genuine consistency/adversarial pass. Do NOT refresh a README or retune a classifier again."
  ]
}
